--- PART 2/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The parent's fitness: 276.85. The next is 271.53. So parent is only 5 points ahead. A small mistake could drop it. We want to improve without losing. The parent's weaknesses in probes: one_D_TFT (2.5), four_D_TFT (1.6), sustained_D (0.858), periodic_D (2.3)."
STRATEGY: The parent is a forgiving TFT-like strategy that cooperates initially, retaliates on opponent defections, and forgives after streaks. The trace simulates the parent and proposed variants against controlled probes (one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, periodic_D) and against population slots. It proposes changes to forgiveness thresholds, consecutive-defection handling, endgame defection, and exploitation detection.

--- PART 3/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The parent's fitness is 276.85, highest. So we should be very careful about changing its core behavior." and "Given the parent is already optimized, maybe the best strategy is just the parent with last-round D."
STRATEGY: Parent is TFT-with-forgiveness: cooperate if opponent's last move was C; on D, count consecutive defections and forgive probabilistically (0.2 at 2, 0.1 at >=3), else defect. Simulated against probes one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, sustained_D and population slots (slot 2, slot 5, slot 9). Changed by adding last-round defection at n==99, keeping parent's forgiveness otherwise.

--- PART 4/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The probe measurements show parent's behavior against four_D_TFT: score 1.6." and "The only guaranteed improvement is last-round D. So I'll stick with that."
STRATEGY: Parent cooperates initially, copies opponent's last move, and after consecutive defections retaliates with probabilistic forgiveness (0.1 at >=3 defections, 0.2 at exactly 2). Simulated against TFT/ALLC/always-defect/periodic probes. Changed by adding a final-round defection at n==99, keeping forgiveness probabilities unchanged.
